__: One document and the canonical YAML the store writes for it, pinned byte for byte. Read by crates/pve-meta-core/tests/formats.rs (format::dump/parse) and by ui-extjs/testing/smoke.js, which runs the same document through the built .wasm as its end-to-end check that the core loads and answers.
__why: There is one YAML emitter -- the editor's codec is pve-meta-core compiled for the browser -- so this table no longer holds two implementations together. Its one job is to notice when a serde_yaml_ng upgrade moves the bytes: every line the emitter lays out differently is a line the editor's diff would then attribute to whatever was being edited, and nothing else would say so before a user saw it.
__scope: The values are what has historically broken hand-written YAML: structural punctuation, quote characters, comment markers, strings that look like numbers/booleans/nulls, non-ASCII including characters whose UTF-8 has a byte in the C1 range, and the container shapes. Keys are deliberately plain -- a document key is limited to the path charset (DESIGN section 2), so only values can be hostile.
